title: Desmarets to an unnamed correspondent, Marly, 4 June 1710 (DECODE R10198)

documents.shelfmark: DECODE R10198 (Desmaretz_1); holding library not given

plaintext.source: The French prose lines between the figure lines do not decipher the figures (four alignment models); no decipherment found.

transcription.notes: Low resolution; a few digits (e.g. 538/558, 115) uncertain.

system.summary: Numerical code of about 570 values (groups 1-568), probably a homophonic syllabic nomenclator, interleaved line by line with clear French prose.

prior_solution.where: DECODE marks it 'Partially decrypted', apparently counting the clear prose lines; no printed text found

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: EM aligners em.py, em2.py, em3.py, emw.py

solution.what: Fetched record metadata and three page images from DECODE with the shared cookie; only 590 px exists.
Transcribed 34 French/figure line pairs and 22 figure-only lines from 3x enlarged crops.
French lines are an interlinear decipherment; build key by aligning them to the figures (letter EM per line, global, with boundary priors; word-level EM).
Line-offset overlap test and repeat/frequency statistics: figures are a real code (183 types/471, repeated 6-gram) but not the text above them.
Web search for a printed text; DECODE key records 1700-1715 for a French ministerial key.

outcome.method_basis: The French lines between the figure lines were shown not to decipher the 471-group numerical code (four alignment models); no key on DECODE or in print was found.
outcome.notes: Leads: Boislisle, Correspondance des controleurs generaux III; AE CP Hollande 1710.
